notes.title: Smoother learning curve: access the heart of CHR$(143)!
notes.notes:
[h3]Historical difficulty of CHR$(143) no longer stands in the way of a deeper discovery of the game[/h3]

Opt for the [b]easier difficulty level[/b], with a smoother learning curve, and [b]go further in the game[/b]!

Version 1.30 is designed to make the game [b]more accessible[/b] with 2 major additions:
[olist]
[*] the player can opt anytime for the [b]easier difficulty level[/b] 
(currently available for most of the first 22 levels, as well as for a few more advanced ones...)
[*] [b]graphic explanations[/b] are available in some briefings in order to explain complex mechanisms in greater details
[/olist]

Whether you're an [b]old owner[/b] or a [b]newcomer[/b], access the [b]full richness of the CHR$(143) universe[/b]!

notes.title: CHR$(143) version 1.28: new and improved building strategies!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Version 1.28[/b] has been released :-)[/h3]

This version introduces a [b]fun new feature[/b] (which has been much requested...)

[b]Four new building strategies[/b] have been introduced. These are explained at the end of level 11, but if you have solved it already and don't want to solve it again, here are a few hints:

[list][*]the 2 historical strategies ("[b]upward[/b]" and "[b]downward[/b]") are now completed by "[b]leftward[/b]" and "[b]rightward[/b]": nothing revolutionary, the agent builds in an imposed direction (and digs in the opposite direction beforehand): simple and stupid, but very predictable...

[*]the 5th strategy is "[b]bestward[/b]": the agent chooses the best of the first 4 strategies according to what there is to build (which is often sufficient and relatively predictable)

[*]the 6th and last strategy is "[b]smartward[/b]": this is by far the most advanced one, but it is much less predictable (even if perfectly deterministic) and, let's be humble, rarely as perfect as what one could do with one's own brain! However, you might get used to it (and it's a bit hard to give it up...)
[/list]
In any case, none of these strategies should damage your agent, unless there are danger zones nearby...

PS. you can use the [b]setup menu[/b] to set the [b]default strategy[/b] when entering a level...

notes.title: New Workshop Level "Water, water"
notes.notes:
This is an original [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2968971983]workshop level[/url] with a very simple goal:

You have an infinite source of water and you need to [b]pour as much as possible into the big pipe in one minute![/b] That's all...

Design the device of your choice, whether it is automatic or manual, whether it uses CPUs or not... and maximize that amount. By checking the worldwide statistics sharing in the setup, you can compare your result with other players...

[list]
[*] Can you dump more than 1000m3?
[*] What is the maximum possible?
[*] Who will be the World Champion?
[/list]
[b]Don't be shy, have a try ;^)[/b]

notes.title: New Workshop Level "Automatic Raindrops"

This new workshop level uses the [b]score management feature[/b] from version 1.27. Once you have solved the level, you can try to optimize your code to get the shortest functional listing. Compare your design with other players, [b]compete for the first place in the world![/b]

notes.title: Version 1.27: Korean, polishing, and ranking for user levels!
notes.notes:
[b]Version 1.27[/b](.03) introduces various developments, the most notable of which are:
[list]
[*] [b]Korean language[/b] support (thanks to the recent evolution of DeepL...)
[*] [b]level polishing[/b], again and again, integrating various feedbacks and notably the latest known twitch stream
(level 4 is less and less nightmarish btw!)
[*] [b]some bug fixes[/b] (one of which paralyzed the agent while trying to move a too heavy load...)
[*] and, last but not least, an [b]experimental global workshop-levels-statistics management[/b] feature:
[b]optimize your design and win the first place![/b]
(requires checking the "statistics sharing" option in the setup menu)
[/list]
I'd like to take this opportunity to [b]thank all the CHR$(143) players[/b], all over the world, with a special mention to those who share their experience on the Discord or, even better, through reviews... (and sometimes both, for the most exceptional among them ;^)

[b]Greetings to all![/b]

notes.title: End of the year version: various small improvements...
notes.notes:
I would like to take this moment to warmly thank all the players who give me feedback or publish videos of their games. Thanks to them, CHR$(143) is improving little by little. 

Among other things, version 1.26.26 [b]slightly simplifies the diabolical level 18[/b]... and [b]fixes a small bug in the terrifying level 71[/b]! (even if... that was a bug that could sometimes allow to win more easily!!)

Additional detail: the agent will now refuse to [b]automatically[/b] build an item that would lead to [b]locking yourself without oxygen[/b] ;^)

And to send a very humble message of better mutual understanding between peoples, [b]three new languages are supported[/b]: Polish, Turkish and Ukrainian... 

[b]All the best to you all.[/b]

notes.title: Localization : CHR$(143) now available in your language!
notes.notes:
The main texts of CHR$(143) can now be displayed in 8 languages ([b]English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese and Chinese[/b]). Much of the new texts are based on machine translations, they may not win the Nobel Prize in Literature but they are often quite accurate and will make the game accessible to people who are not very fluent in English!

This version also includes an other "on-the-fly" translation feature (which requires an account DeepL API; you can get one for free) to translate texts into [b]even more languages[/b] and/or to translate texts from user levels (e.g. Steam Workshop).

[b]The language barrier is no longer an excuse: welcome to new players who dare to take up the CHR$(143) challenge![/b]

notes.title: Update Notes for v1.24.17
notes.notes:
Game Mechanics:
- resources are given back when the player cancels a building operation
- conveyors no longer trigger blackouts (they stop working when there is no more power available)
CPUs:
- new CPU command B to request a break (if allowed by level...)
- new CPU superuser commands to set up and compute custom scores... (for user levels with optimization goals!)
User interface:
- the volumes of different musics have been roughly equalized (that's why the update seems huge, sorry for the inconvenience...)
- the user can now adjust the volumes of the sounds/music (in the setup and during the game)
- the "load user level" window now appears in the center of the screen
- the listing editor window will warn the user if there is no more CPU in position (e.g. has moved)
- F5/F6/F7 can now be used to pause/run/step when the listing window is open
Levels:
- levels with "respawning devices" will add extra time before calculating world records
- better explanation in level 16 "Sun is fun" ("reach 1200kW")
